notes: οἱ … λαμβάνοντες splits under rule 32: the article takes 'they' and the participle keeps 'that received', the ASV having written two English words, so rule 90's single-word arm does not apply.
Both δίδραχμα tokens take 'half shekel' headed on 'shekel' (rules 24, 66); the ASV's marginal gloss corroborates the coin name.
Ὁ before διδάσκαλος is emptied by the possessive on ὑμῶν (rule 20), and τῷ before Πέτρῳ is unrepresented with 'to' riding on the name (rules 21, 23).
